{
    "content": "<p>Got this error after migrating a SP2007 application to SP2010.</p>\n<!--more-->\n<blockquote>\n<p>Activation could not be completed because the InfoPath Forms Services support\nfeature is not present.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<p>The feature it is complaining about is a hidden feature with displayname\n<code>IPFSSiteFeatures</code>. This feature was already enabled on the migrated\napplication...but resolving the error was as simple as disabling and then\nre-enabling the feature. Here's the PowerShell to do that:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-powershell\">Disable-SPFeature &quot;IPFSSiteFeatures&quot; -url &quot;http://yourwebapp&quot;;\nEnable-SPFeature &quot;IPFSSiteFeatures&quot; -url &quot;http://yourwebapp&quot;;\n</code></pre>\n",

        "rawInput": "\nGot this error after migrating a SP2007 application to SP2010.\n\n<!--more-->\n\n> Activation could not be completed because the InfoPath Forms Services support\n> feature is not present.\n\nThe feature it is complaining about is a hidden feature with displayname\n`IPFSSiteFeatures`. This feature was already enabled on the migrated\napplication...but resolving the error was as simple as disabling and then\nre-enabling the feature. Here's the PowerShell to do that:\n\n```powershell\nDisable-SPFeature \"IPFSSiteFeatures\" -url \"http://yourwebapp\";\nEnable-SPFeature \"IPFSSiteFeatures\" -url \"http://yourwebapp\";\n```\n",
